priorStatuses.title: Remove the message listener during cleanup

findings.title: [P2] Remove the message listener during cleanup
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: Current src/socket.ts line 3 returns an empty disposer while line 2 still registers handler with socket.on("message", handler). The full PR diff confirms this PR removed the prior socket.off("message", handler) call, so cleanup retains the listener.
